title: Re-evaluate real shadow evidence failures after the confirmation audit fix

answers.exactly_why: roska4_calm and roska4_stress genuinely failed on data refusals - nothing to do with the confirmation file

roska4_calm.real_cause: observed 0 of 1 decided; both phases gate_refused - TRACK1_CALM_DECIDE_0932 (missing_session, entry_quote_absent, stale, partial_coverage) and TRACK1_CALM_OBSERVE_1002 (missing_session, stale, partial_coverage)

roska4_stress.real_cause: observed 18 of 24; the six slots from 10:35 to 11:00 gate_refused (missing_session, stale)
roska4_stress.classification: REAL - data/provider failure at the window open

global_nkd.standing_reason_meaning: a not-judgeable note, not a fault
global_nkd.classification: PASSED ON THE DAY - the later sweep overwrote it and its only failing reason was the removed rule

roska4_swing.classification: NOT RE-JUDGEABLE - no same-day clean row and the checkpoint cannot be reconstructed

checkpoint_wrong_day_explained.mechanism: the checkpoint check compares the day under judgment against live_positions.track1.json, a SINGLE LIVE FILE overwritten on every run
checkpoint_wrong_day_explained.consequence: re-judging ANY past day reports checkpoint_wrong_day, every time, forever

reports_per_sleeve: classification (which reasons came from a removed rule, and whether the row was failed SOLELY by those)
reevaluated (what the current code says, WITH whether it is entitled to say it)

loose_end_that_check_found.what: reasons.append(R_CONFIRMATION_FILE) was still present in the acceptance module after Stage 5ZZZ-A
loose_end_that_check_found.why_it_mattered: unreachable only because no check emitted the string it matched on - a thin thing to rest on, and it made the reason look live to anything reading the file to learn which reasons the code can produce

not_wired_into_the_gate.reasoning: turning a stored failure into a pass moves the only gate still holding this route; that has to be an operator's decision with the reasoning in front of them, not a side effect of a reader
not_wired_into_the_gate.and_on_this_day: it would change nothing anyway - two sleeves failed for real, so 2026-08-27 is a failing day under any honest reading

reasons: the rows are append-only JSONL carrying provenance (audit_trigger, audit_pid, ts); a hand-written row would carry my pid and a trigger no other row means
2026-08-27 fails on merit, so a corrected row states the same verdict
2026-08-28's rows will be rewritten by the scheduled audits from the fixed code
no_corrected_rows_written.verified: audit directory digests identical before and after; a test recomputes them around a reinterpretation call

failing_checks.name: no_failing_days
failing_checks.detail: 4 FAIL day(s) in the qualifying window, at most 0 allowed
failing_checks.nature: real - 08-24 and 08-25 coverage and schema failures, 08-26 Calm coverage, 08-27 the Calm and Stress data refusals

failing_checks.name: every_sleeve_passed_at_least_once
failing_checks.nature: the one place the stale rule still costs something - global_nkd DID pass on 08-27 in a row a since-removed rule overwrote

results.mutation_design: most WIDEN the classifier - register a live reason as stale, dismiss a re-evaluation entitled to speak, wire it into the gate, let it write. Two narrow it, since a classifier that dismisses nothing would satisfy every safety test and be useless.

honest_greens_before_retargeting.why: wrote `{} or {...}`, which Python evaluates to the non-empty dict - a no-op
substituted the re-evaluated verdict into the stored field, invisible because every sleeve is FAIL both ways on this day
honest_greens_before_retargeting.response: a synthetic record that makes the two disagree by construction

still_open: the Calm and Stress data refusals of 2026-08-27 - missing_session, stale, partial_coverage, entry_quote_absent. This stage identified them; nobody has yet asked why the provider had no session at 09:32 and at 10:35.
global_nkd's overwritten PASS - whether the readiness reader should keep the last row or the best row is a real design question, and changing it moves a gate, so it belongs to an operator
the audit's Calm window still reads ['10:00','10:00'] and expects 1 slot where two phases now run
